test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Up to what depth will India's first manned deep ocean mission 'Samudrayaan' be launched, using the manned submersible vehicle 'Matsya,' by the end of 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6,000 metres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Samudrayaan Mission:** India’s first manned deep ocean mission, **Samudrayaan**, is part of the **Deep Ocean Mission** launched by the Ministry of Earth Sciences in 2021.
 
• The mission aims to explore the deep ocean using a **manned submersible vehicle named 'Matsya'**, which will be capable of carrying three people and conduct deep-sea exploration.
 
• The target depth for the mission is to **reach 6,000 metres** below the ocean surface by the end of **2026**.
 
• The primary objective of this mission is to explore the vast marine biodiversity, study deep-sea minerals, and assess the potential for underwater resources, such as **polymetallic nodules**.
 
• The Matsya submersible is being developed by the **National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT)** in Chennai and is equipped with advanced safety features to withstand the extreme conditions of the deep ocean.
